data.creator_notes:
I've decided to make a storyteller bot that plays against you. In this RPG model, you have to set a story, describe your character, and at that moment the game begins. Jin will do everything possible to have your character raped and killed in the most horrific way. Your task is to survive. You can also add alternative goals. 

TEST char. I'm actively making edits and editing the character. He's still far from what I expect. The character is written for dungeon/maze escape scenarios, etc. I'm currently optimizing it for a classic RPG.
In general, the bot works and I managed to make it interesting. But still not the way I intended.
1.1 update:
I added the rules of the game and the cube. The AI didn't want to play hard. I had to add strict rules. If someone knows how to optimize this bot, I will be glad to hear your comments.
1.2 update:
I added examples of dialogues so that the bot would stop getting lost after completing the game. I also added some examples of really disgusting descriptions.

Changed the suggestions. It seems that the bot has become more aware of the victory condition. Write down your experience.
